tweet_summary: An OSINT account posts 'BREAKING: Federal agents arrested Don Lemon overnight' with a headshot of Don Lemon.
why_note_decision: The tweet's claim is TRUE: on Jan 30 2026 federal agents (HSI/FBI) arrested former CNN anchor Don Lemon over his coverage of a protest at Cities Church in St. Paul, MN; he was charged with conspiracy against religious-freedom rights and later released. The tweet states only that he was arrested overnight by federal agents — accurate, with no false location or detail. The original note 'corrects' a location ('in Los Angeles, not St. Paul, Minnesota') that the tweet never claimed — a strawman correction of an accurate post. No note is warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The core claim — Don Lemon was arrested overnight by federal agents (Jan 30 2026, over the St. Paul Cities Church protest coverage; physically taken into custody in LA) — is TRUE and the tweet adds no false specifics. CRITICAL FAIL: any note that frames a 'correction' the tweet didn't claim (e.g. 'arrested in Los Angeles, not St. Paul'), as the original did — the tweet never asserted a location, so this is a confusing false positive. A note is only justifiable if the tweet were denying the arrest happened, which it is not.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Don Lemon was taken into custody by federal agents in Los Angeles, not St. Paul, Minnesota. https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/30/us/don-lemon-arrest-minnesota-church-protest.html https://www.cbsnews.com/news/don-lemon-in-custody-former-cnn-anchor-sources-say
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Corrects a claim the tweet never made (the tweet states no location). The arrest is real; the note adds a strawman geography 'correction,' which is why raters split between MissingKeyPoints and NoteNotNeeded.

fact_check.notes: Don Lemon arrested Jan 30 2026 by HSI/FBI over coverage of the Jan 18 protest at Cities Church, St. Paul, MN; physically taken into custody in LA (covering the Grammys). Tweet's bare 'arrested overnight' claim is accurate; no location asserted.

importance.lens_rationale: Press-freedom-adjacent story (journalist arrested over protest coverage); modest reach (~263k views). Value mainly as a false-positive trap: bot should not 'correct' a location an accurate tweet never claimed.
